summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 51 yen/share (from 36 yen); year-end dividend raised to 93 yen/share (from 86 yen). Full-year payout ratio including buyback and cancellation 62.6%. Dividend policy: progressive payouts targeting 40%+ consolidated payout ratio. Stock split 1:4 effective 1 October 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Earnings Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Sanyo Chemical Industries revised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 upward. The interim dividend (6 months ended 30 September 2026) is raised to 51 yen per share from the prior forecast of 36 yen per share. The year-end dividend is raised to 93 yen per share from 86 yen per share. The revision follows upward revision of full-year earnings guidance: operating profit increased from 10.0 billion yen to 13.0 billion yen, and net income attributable to parent raised from 9.0 billion yen to 11.0 billion yen. The company stated its shareholder return policy targets a consolidated payout ratio of 40% or above and implements progressive dividend policy. Including the concurrent self-tender share buyback and cancellation program, the expected consolidated total payout ratio for the fiscal year reaches 62.6%. The dividend figures reflect a planned 1-for-4 stock split effective 1 October 2026.
